title: 菊花賞の後に・虚ろなる焔

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why… Why?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Everyone was moved when Creek sprinted forward. I thought I responded in kind and rose to the challenge, so… why?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why couldn't I keep up with her?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Aaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki bites her lip in frustration. As soon as I see her turn her back to the stands, I dash for the runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm gasping for breath as I find her standing dead still in the middle of the tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I'm so sorry. What a disgraceful performance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There are no words to excuse me for subjecting you to that.
choice_data_list: The distance was pretty tough, huh?
The distance was pretty tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like the long-distance Kikuka Sho was pretty hard on her. It's unfortunate she lost, but there's no reason for her to beat herself up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No! It wasn't the distance, but my own heart that failed me! I knew not to let her get away, yet it was no use!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Huh?! Her presence is looming even larger! It feels strong enough to block out the sky itself!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I have to fight back! Come on, blaze! Burn!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Burn!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Defeat is not an option! Win! I must… win!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why?! Why won't the flames light?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: All that happened is I got more confused. The flames sputtered and I just kicked uselessly at the turf…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I begged my weary legs to bring me to her, but they only got heavier!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How… how can anyone be so unsightly?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It would be one thing if my raging flames were toying with me… but to finish without igniting them at all?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Judging from the disappointment I feel, I certainly wanted to win…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So why?! Why did my feelings fail me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's more remorseful about her performance than about the loss itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking back on it, Yaeno Muteki was not especially motivated to face Super Creek. I just might know why.
choice_data_list: Do you think it's because Ardan and Chiyono O weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals, the ones who stoke her fierce blaze, were nowhere to be found. Until now, Yaeno Muteki has always been driven by a powerful desire to defeat the pair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without them here driving her today, that passionate desire for victory was gone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My desire to defeat Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan…

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh! Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't care if my legs shatter! I will burn out my very lifeforce! And that light will serve as proof that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine! It's miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (…No! Losing is not an option. I will not… abiiide… defeeeat!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was your incredible passion that drew today's performance out of me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I didn't want to be outdone… I wanted to light my soul ablaze and burn just as brightly as you two.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's true… My desire to defeat Chiyono O and Ardan is what set my heart aflame.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Their incredible obsession with the Derby pulled me along in their wake…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is not the word I would use to describe what I felt today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. Yaeno Muteki certainly wasn't hellbent on winning today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is driven by her desire to race toe-to-toe with her role model, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan runs desperately, prepared to sacrifice her very life in order to leave behind proof of her existence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both have goals they obsess over, and that in turn pushes them towards victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It goes beyond simply wanting to win. Their obsessions won't let them yield to anyone, and in the end, that becomes the decisive factor towards victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An obsession like that is not something that can be given. Yaeno Muteki must find this spark within herself to be able to ignite the blaze.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't simply rely on Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan. I must find my own obsession…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: But you can take your time. You'll still get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to her that obsession provides an extra edge, but even a mild desire is enough for victory as long as she has the physical ability.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Very well. Let's continue training as we have been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know if she'll ever find an obsession of her own, but I have to leave that to her. All I can do is watch over her in the meantime.
choice_data_list: Now then, about our next goal…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …One moment, please.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Okay.
choice_data_list: I was thinking the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that, after seeing her performance today, I feel medium-distance races may suit her better than long-distance ones.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So that's why you've chosen the Osaka Hai, a medium-distance spring G1.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have no objections. As long as it's a G1, I expect I should be able to face worthy opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we settle on the Osaka Hai as our next goal!
